private: Your images stay on your device
paste: or paste with Ctrl / ⌘ + V. Multiple images welcome.
formats: JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG, ICO
sampleHint: No image handy? Try a locally generated sample.
unitHint: 1 KB = 1,000 bytes. Results are checked against the exact byte limit.
resizeToFit: Allow smaller dimensions to meet the target
formatHint: JPG uses a white background. Animated images become still images. EXIF is removed.
dimensionsHint: Leave blank to keep dimensions. Aspect ratio is preserved; images are never enlarged. ICO is limited to 256 px.
emptyHint: Choose images to see sizes, previews and downloads here.
cancelled: Cancelled. Completed images are still available.
failed: Could not process this image. Check that the file is valid and try a smaller image.
tooLarge: This image exceeds the 50 MB or 40 megapixel limit. Try a smaller image.
codecError: Could not load the image decoder. Connect to the internet and try again.
timeout: This image took too long to process. Try a smaller image.
targetMissed: Above target — allow smaller dimensions or choose JPG / WebP.
larger: Output is larger than the original
zipError: Could not create the ZIP. Your individual downloads are still available.
zipLimit: This batch is too large to ZIP safely in this browser. Download images individually.
busy: Wait for the current batch or cancel it before adding more images.
batchLimit: Choose up to 50 images per batch.
memoryLimit: Clear or download existing results before adding more images (100 MB result limit).
invalidSettings: Check your settings: quality 1–100, file size 1 KB–100 MB, dimensions 1–8,000 px.
related: More ways to make your images useful
offlineReady: Offline files saved for both languages and all supported decoders on this browser.
offlineFailed: Some offline files could not be saved. Reconnect and try again.
update: An update is ready. Download and clear your results, then reload.
noJs: Enable JavaScript to process images on your device. The guides below are available without JavaScript.
notFound: This page could not be found
settingsChanged: Settings apply to the next batch.
